title: Python malformed first fragment emits abort without terminal hold-down
description: _AuthenticatedReassemblyManager.receive returns Receiver-Abort when a context-free authenticated payload under Rule 0x78/0x79 fails Fragment.from_bytes, but it records no rejection/tombstone/high-water. The same pinned signer can send each fresh malformed frame and force an unbounded abort response, contrary to the spec's unrecoverable-error terminal hold-down and bounded response behavior. Record a bounded rejected/aborted tombstone before responding, advance high-water on later terminal requests as specified, suppress non-terminal repeats, persist it, and add malformed/churn/reboot tests.
